title: 13th MEU | ACE Conducts Landing Procedures Aboard USS Makin Island B-Roll
description: U.S. Marine Corps aircraft assigned to 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit, conduct carrier and deck landing qualifications aboard Wasp-class amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD 8), Oct. 1, 2026. The 13th MEU is currently underway aboard the Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group in the U.S. 3rd Fleet area of operations demonstrating the United States’ long-term commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Fernando Cruz Martinez)
